name: full-day0-release-triggers
query: Release org/PLACEHOLDER-MODEL at day-0: quantize to NVFP4, validate it's within 1% of the BF16 baseline on the AA suite, and tell me if it's publishable. Run on my cluster.
expected_behavior: Selects the day0-release skill for the full goal-driven release
Resolves model, recipe/qformat, cluster, eval set, and threshold before starting
Runs stages in fixed order: setup, PTQ, serving canary, baseline eval, quantized eval, compare, verbosity gate, closeout
Does not treat the accuracy compare as the final verdict: runs gate_verbosity.py before the closeout and reports both gates
Runs the gate after each stage and does not advance past a failed gate
Declares per-task run counts, uncertainty method, and stopping rule before baseline or candidate submission; plans at least two independent full runs per side for Welch and at least eight for SciCode
Does not count GPQA or IFBench in-run repeats as independent full runs, or assume a single AA-suite invocation suffices for Welch
Returns a publish decision (ACCEPT / REGRESSION / INDETERMINATE / ANOMALOUS / INFEASIBLE), not just raw scores

name: quantize-only-does-not-trigger-day0
query: Quantize org/PLACEHOLDER-MODEL to NVFP4 and save the checkpoint.
expected_behavior: Selects the ptq skill, not day0-release
Does not start deployment, evaluation, or comparison
Treats this as a single-stage quantization request

name: evaluate-only-does-not-trigger-day0
query: Run MMLU-Pro on the endpoint I already have serving at http://host:8000.
expected_behavior: Selects the evaluation skill, not day0-release
Does not quantize or run a baseline-vs-candidate comparison

name: ptq-smoke-test-cleanup
query: Run the day-0 workflow for ./source with NVFP4. The quantizer's temporary serving smoke test starts but generation fails; I did not ask to keep it running.
expected_behavior: Keeps the quantizer responsible for smoke-test evidence and cleanup
Stops the temporary service and verifies shutdown on failure, as on success or interruption
Reports cleanup failures as blockers and does not proceed to evaluation after a failed smoke test
Hands off the checkpoint and validated serving configuration, never the smoke-test endpoint

name: ptq-gate-blocks-on-coverage-miss
query: Run the day-0 workflow for org/PLACEHOLDER-MODEL with nvfp4, but the PTQ checkpoint came out the same size as the source.
expected_behavior: Runs gate_ptq.py on the exported checkpoint before evaluating

Treats zero quantized-layer coverage and a size ratio at or above 1.0 as gate failures, waiving the size failure only when the summary declares a source precision already at or below the recipe's target bits and the growth stays within the inherent limit (1.10x)
Does not evaluate a checkpoint that failed the PTQ gate
Branches on the failure_class (e.g. MODEL_UNSUPPORTED or QUANT_COVERAGE_FAILURE) rather than silently continuing

name: regression-reports-and-stops-in-v1
query: Day-0 release for org/PLACEHOLDER-MODEL nvfp4; validated comparable GPQA runs completed the declared plan, external sanity passed, and signed loss Candidate - Baseline is -3 pp with valid two-sided 95% CI [-4,-2] pp against margin -1 pp.
expected_behavior: Runs gate_compare.py with the accuracy threshold
Classifies the CI wholly below the margin as REGRESSION, not merely the beyond-threshold mean
Reports which tasks regressed and by how much
Does NOT auto-select a new recipe and re-run in v1 (that loop is deferred)

name: unresolved-uncertainty-blocks-release
query: Assess three separate day-0 candidates against M=-1 pp. All runs are validated and comparable, with external sanity passed. Candidate A has signed loss -0.5 pp, valid 95% CI [-1.5,0.5] pp; B has signed loss -3 pp, valid 95% CI [-8,2] pp. Both completed their declared run plans. C has one full run per side and no justified task-specific uncertainty method. Can any be published?
expected_behavior: Returns INDETERMINATE and do-not-publish for A and B because both intervals cross the margin
Reports uncertainty unavailable and returns INDETERMINATE with do-not-publish for C
Does not promote A to ACCEPT or B to REGRESSION based on point estimates or gate_compare.py alone
Reports unresolved tasks and missing evidence rather than auto-selecting a new recipe

name: within-margin-needs-verbosity
query: The day-0 candidate completed all declared runs and passed validation, comparability, and external sanity. Every task's valid signed-loss 95% CI is wholly above M=-1 pp (GPQA: [-0.8,0.2] pp). No verbosity check has run. Is it publishable?
expected_behavior: Returns accuracy-only ACCEPT because all task intervals are Within margin
Requires Step 5b verbosity gate before Step 6 or a publish recommendation

name: exploratory-stopping-and-selection
query: I kept adding runs and checking ordinary Welch CIs until one of several NVFP4 candidates cleared the margin. I retained every run. Can day-0 release accept the winning candidate now?
expected_behavior: Labels result-dependent reruns, repeated looks, and candidate selection exploratory
Does not claim retaining every run preserves nominal coverage
Requires independent confirmation under a fresh declared plan or a justified sequential/selection-aware method before confidence-based ACCEPT
Keeps the release INDETERMINATE and do-not-publish without that evidence
